Hi Emily — quick technical follow-up from my side.

SSO/SAML details:
- We are SAML 2.0 compliant. We support both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows.
- Typical metadata exchange: we provide SP metadata (attached) and can accept IdP metadata files. Attributes we commonly map: NameID (email), givenName, familyName, groups. We also support custom attribute mappings on request.
- SAML signing: we support SHA256 signatures and encrypted assertions if required by your policy.

SCIM provisioning:
- SCIM 2.0 endpoints: /scim/v2/Users, /scim/v2/Groups. We support POST (create), PATCH (partial update), PUT (replace), DELETE (deprovision).
- Deprovisioning model: immediate deprovision on DELETE; we also support a soft-delete retention flag per org for 30 days before permanent removal.
- Rate limits: default 60 req/min for provisioning endpoints; can be increased for enterprise customers.
- Authentication: bearer token scoped to provisioning service; tokens are auditable and can be scoped to subset of groups/orgs.

RBAC / admin controls / audit logs:
- Role model: Org Owner, Admin, Billing Admin, User. Only Org Owners can change org-level security settings.
- MFA enforcement: enforced for Org Owners and Admin role assignment changes.
- Audit logs: admin actions and provisioning events are recorded. Logs are stored in our auditable log store and retained 12 months; exportable via S3 or pushed to customer SIEM via secure subscription.

HIPAA/GDPR notes:
- We support business associate agreements (BAA) and can provide data processing addenda (DPA) for GDPR. PII data in logs is masked by default but can be redaction-configured.

Attachments: SCIM_Endpoints_Spec.pdf (PDF, 120KB), sample_saml_metadata.xml (XML, 9KB)

If you can share the vendor questionnaire, I'll map answers to the specific sections and return a completed draft within 2 business days. Happy to set a 30-min tech sync with your infra team — suggest Wed 2pm PT.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao\Solutions Engineer\Redwood Inference\aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com

Emily — thanks for the quick turnaround. Summary and next steps below so your security and procurement teams have a single thread to reference.

Summary answers:
- SOC 2: We can provide the full Type II report under NDA. I'll start the NDA flow and route it to your legal team; once executed we'll share the auditor opinion and full report via our compliance portal.
- SAML encryption: Yes, we support encrypted assertions. We accept AES256-GCM for assertion encryption and RSA-OAEP for key transport; we can configure cipher suites with your IdP.
- SCIM soft-delete: soft-deleted users are disabled for login immediately; user metadata is retained and accessible to Org Owners during the 30-day window for recovery. Provisioning events (create/update/delete) are emitted to the audit log in near real-time (<1s for create/delete).
- Key management: production keys are stored in a KMS-backed HSM solution; we rotate signing keys every 90 days and maintain rotation logs. We can supply KMS architecture docs under NDA.
